definitions.explanation: The cylindrical bundle of nerve fibers and tissue enclosed within the spine, connecting the brain to the rest of the body's nervous system.

examples.english: The spinal cord transmits signals from the brain to the entire body.

notes:
USAGE:
A medical term. The internet slang phrase {脊髄反射|せきずいはんしゃ} (spinal reflex) is sometimes used figuratively to mean responding without thinking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脊髄|せきずい}⟦{損傷|そんしょう}→損傷：21079_sonshou⟧ (spinal cord injury)
- {脊髄|せきずい}⟦{反射|はんしゃ}→反射：08390_hansha⟧ (spinal reflex)
- {脊髄|せきずい}⟦{液|えき}→液：02270_eki⟧ (spinal fluid)
- {脊髄|せきずい}⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧ (spinal nerve)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{脊椎|せきつい}→脊椎：06006_sekitsui⟧: spine, vertebral column (the bones)
- {脊柱|せきちゅう}: spinal column
